english.title: Convey thing in / out detention centre / to person
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[conveyed]_
(B)_[attempted to convey]_

a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THING..),

(C)_[into a detention centre, namely **(..SPECIFY CENTRE..),]_
(D)_[out of a detention centre, namely **(..SPECIFY CENTRE..),]_
(E)_[to a detained person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_

contrary to detention centre rules and was not as a result guilty of an offence under paragraph 4 or 5 of Schedule 12 to the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 6(1) and (3) of Schedule 12 to the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) Paragraph 4 of Schedule 12 to the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999 concerns assisting detained persons to escape from a detention centre or short-term holding facility.
(ii) Paragraph 5 of Schedule 12 to the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999 relates to bringing alcohol into a detention centre or to a detained person.
